collection_protocol: Serial dependent SHA256 CPU tasks; randomized task order; one warmup, three calibration runs, six complete held-out runs. Catalog nominal_ms is rounded median calibration duration; reward is synthetic.
reward_source: arbitrary deterministic synthetic rewards, not measured value
limitations: Exploratory container-host CPU microbenchmark; unknown contention/thermal conditions; calibration and holdout share host; randomization does not guarantee independence; no policy-specific contention or scheduling overhead; self-reported provenance is not authenticated. Both policies selected all 24 tasks, so this cohort is non-discriminative.
record_note: Compact derivative of original local manifest. Exact catalog and trace CSV bytes retained; omitted original warmup/calibration order logs and per-task digest list.
